private_policy_additions: Seasons repeat every 45 days from the 2022-10-28 05:00 GMT+8 source season (season number counted from it); ranked play closes at 00:00 GMT+8 of day 45 and INFO answers is_close until the next 05:00 opening (user decision 2026-10-20).

A new season fully resets stars, Lord points, statistics, streaks, exchanges and awards; missions, mission time, the saved defense and king_coin/region_coin balances carry over (user decision 2026-10-20 full reset).

Matching offers one opponent with a saved five-girl defense: ranked from the star band [0.8 s, 1.2 s] widened by 0.1 per side until someone is found, then anyone; practice from anyone; deterministic per player, season and match counter (user decision 2026-10-20 widen).

A started match left 10 minutes without FIGHT, a STOP, and a started match superseded by a new START settle as an attacker loss without a battle: stars/streak/statistics only, no coins or mission progress, defender unchanged (user decision 2026-10-20).

Lord points (Challenger, 95 stars): min(50, 10 + floor(0.1 x max(0, opponent points - own points))) added on a win; a loss removes the same formula with the difference reversed, floored at 0; defenders' points are unchanged; region_count_param2 has no inferred role.
Multi-star drops (third consecutive failed defense, -3) floor at region_arena_fail_protect 10, or at 90 once a player holds 90+; Challenger never drops.

Missions: three distinct region_mission rows drawn by weight; progress only from ranked attacks (kills and damage of the attacker side, the current attack win streak, wins); a completed mission is claimed for king_coin; claim or give-up empties the slot; empty slots refill together 72000 s after the last change.

Exchanges cost king_coin per region_exchange (escalating per season); star-up and awaken require an owned or summoned girl; summon requires a girl the player does not own and has not summoned; awards are keyed by the base (pre-awaken) table id.
A table id owned in several copies resolves to the strongest copy (star, then level, then lowest partner id) at freeze; a defense girl no longer available is left out of the battle.

Defender lineup (girls, pet, season awards) is frozen at START; the defender's current rows are read at FIGHT; the defender pet fights as the real owned pet (the client-resolved path used an uncollected pet with only its star).

FIGHT answers within 15 s (client JSON timeout 20 s); still resolving answers battle_report [] so the client's PLAYOFFS_RETRY path re-sends the same FIGHT after 3 s; resolution continues detached and the reconcile provider settles it regardless.

Season settlement mails every player with at least one ranked fight in the season its final-level region_arena_reward (region_coin, mana, items, frame at 26, skin pack from 15) and the season rank 1 Challenger the champion item 110006001; season order is stars, points, earlier reach, player id.

History (Q_ARENA_HISTORY_WINDOW): INFO/769 statistics and girl usage are per season from ranked attacks; records keep the 20 newest ranked fights (attack and defense, viewer-side win); practice fights leave no record; immutable season settlement rows are retained.
Ranking 301 rank_types 6 lists the season top 50 with level, star, point and fights; 775 (no window caller) and the client-resolved 774/778 are refused.
The daily first-10 coins are granted at settlement through I5 (region_coin, 50 win / 25 loss) and returned through economy_.
deviations_from_plan: Combat resolution flights (detached, deduplicated in-process) moved from oneonone into the Combat application (combat.Service.ResolveDetached); 1 on 1 behaviour unchanged, its stall test double now overrides ResolveDetached.

Combat Participant gained Overlay (mode keys merged into frozen params, never replacing an owner key); the resolver driver applies arena_add_star / arena_awake then xyd.formatRegionArenaHeros / formatRegionArenaPets only for CampaignType 45.
combat.PartnerUse carries the report hero table_id (Arena keys usage by girl); Top Floor and 1 on 1 ignore it.
Identity store gained a read-only ServerNames.ServerNameTx display seam (opponent server names in cross-server Arena surfaces).
contentstore.ArenaTemplatesTx exposes the hero template lineage (base, awakened, super, initial star) of the pinned revision.
First entry bumps the competition root so concurrent first INFO calls of one player serialize into a retry (found by native tests); the same race exists in 1 on 1 LOAD (not changed in 5D).
region_coin is the eco_type 11 'Arena Coin' (SOURCE_FACT, upgraded from inference) and king_coin eco_type 16; both are ENABLED_R4 named scalars with Arena as income owner.
known_limitations: One competition over all logical servers serializes season settlement and fight settlement on the root (lock 603); adequate for private-server scale.
Standings are computed from all competitor rows on each read (no rank index).
No robots: a server with no other defended player cannot match.
The champion portrait item's 45-day lifetime is the item's own definition; Arena grants the item only.
The client season window always prints the source dates (2022-10-28 .. 2022-12-12).
Playoffs (1280-1294), the Arena shop (region shop), the casual arena and PlayerDisplay 1829 history stay unactivated.
1 on 1 LOAD has the same concurrent same-player first-entry race fixed here for Arena (one request fails and the client retries).
lock_order: actor fence 315 -> Arena competition root 603 (first entry, fight settlement, season settlement; matching/START/FIGHT admission read it unlocked) -> Arena player rows (player order) -> Combat locator 609 -> I5 mail 610 -> Achievement 620 -> I5 value 700+; season settlements run in their own transactions before any Arena mutation (settle-before-mutate).
